Available topographic products

Source: R/products.R
n_products.Rd

Available topographic products

Usage

n_products()

Value

A data frame with series, scale and Geonorge metadata identifiers.

Examples

n_products()
#>   series   scale                          metadata_id
#> 1    N50   50000 ea192681-d039-42ec-b1bc-f3ce04c189ac
#> 2   N100  100000 11a70876-5b21-4cc6-8229-902266c4968f
#> 3   N250  250000 442cae64-b447-478d-b384-545bc1d9ab48
#> 4   N500  500000 58e0dbf8-0d47-47c8-8086-107a3fa2dfa4
#> 5  N1000 1000000 aee42bb6-d0e9-4d70-86fe-6ea76c381055
#> 6  N2000 2000000 8d52075d-6ef6-4120-8041-d0c0901f21f7
#> 7  N5000 5000000 c777d53d-8916-4d9d-bae4-6d5140e0c569
